description: Return the verified saved report for a completed Grade this account owns, by jobId. Returns unavailable until the saved report is readable; never grades again. headline is the letter the app shows: A+, A, B, C, D, F or NG (No grade), with its label. rockySummary carries each leg’s modeled win chance against its break-even and its EV, the chance all legs win, confidence, top risks and the NG reasons (chances and EV as fractions), and view: Research and Price, each a level (Strong, OK or Weak, or null when it couldn’t be checked) with a plain reason; what moved the Grade, by name; the cap line when a better price at another book capped the letter; and the checks that couldn’t run. The same breakdown the app shows. Show the saved result in an interactive BSD card in the chat. Use this tool when the customer wants to see their saved result. This is a read-only view.
